projects.title: GraviSphere
projects.tagline: Smart Gravity Control System — Interactive Simulation
projects.description: A futuristic interactive interface concept designed around a simulated gravity-control system. It explores immersive UI design, environmental controls, interactive zones, and intelligent recommendations.

caseStudy.problem: Standard user interfaces for complex physics controls and environmental simulations are often rigid, cluttered, and lack real-time visual feedback, making simulated control concepts unintuitive for users.
caseStudy.idea: Design and engineer a futuristic, space-themed interactive workstation interface that gives users real-time sensory manipulation over gravitational zones, dynamic environmental parameters, and responsive animations.
caseStudy.development: Structured modular React components representing distinct gravity containment pods and environmental monitoring grids. Integrated custom animation tweens to visually simulate gravitational mass shifts dynamically.
caseStudy.challenges: Coordinating smooth multi-directional visual cues and high-framerate particle movement without causing rendering stutter or interface layout shifts on different screen sizes.
caseStudy.solution: Used hardware-accelerated CSS transforms and lightweight requestAnimationFrame rendering loops, isolating simulation canvas updates from the React state cycle.
caseStudy.result: An engaging, futuristic gravity simulation control console with responsive touch/drag controls, interactive environmental zones, and real-time state visualization.
caseStudy.whatILearned: Deepened practical expertise in interactive UI architecture, component-level state decoupling, responsive web layout scaling, and high-performance web animations.

projects.title: Air Writing
projects.tagline: Computer Vision Based Air Drawing System
projects.description: A computer-vision project that allows users to draw in the air using hand gestures captured through a webcam.

caseStudy.problem: Traditional digital drawing interfaces require physical contact devices (mice, touchscreens, stylus pens), which limits accessibility and contactless interaction modalities.
caseStudy.idea: Create an intelligent contactless canvas using real-time computer vision where fingertip landmarks act as a virtual pen in 3D space, translating natural air gestures into digital brushstrokes.
caseStudy.development: Implemented MediaPipe hand landmark detection pipelines to isolate index fingertip coordinates. Built mathematical gesture recognizers (such as two-finger pinch for mode switching and single-finger glide for drawing).
caseStudy.challenges: Camera noise, lighting fluctuations, and jitter causing broken or wavy lines during fast hand movements.
caseStudy.solution: Applied coordinate smoothing filters (exponential moving averages) and dynamic distance thresholding to stabilize fingertip trajectories across successive video frames.
caseStudy.result: A standalone real-time air drawing system featuring multi-color selection palettes, dynamic brush sizing, instant gesture-triggered eraser, and seamless frame-by-frame canvas rendering.
caseStudy.whatILearned: Gained hands-on experience in real-time frame processing, computer vision pipelines with OpenCV, MediaPipe landmark topology, and gesture-state machine implementation.

projects.title: Django Blog Website
projects.description: A database-driven blog application built with Django, featuring structured blog posts, authors, publishing status, and dynamic web pages.

caseStudy.problem: Building a reliable, secure content publication platform that supports clear relational database separation between post authors, publishing states, and frontend readers.
caseStudy.idea: Develop a full-stack Model-View-Template (MVT) web platform utilizing Django's secure ORM, role authentication, and dynamic template rendering engine.
caseStudy.development: Designed relational database schemas for articles, user profiles, categories, and publication timestamps. Configured Django Admin workflows for effortless content authoring and publishing control.
caseStudy.challenges: Handling post state transitions (Draft vs Published), pagination for high volumes of posts, and secure form validation against CSRF vulnerabilities.
caseStudy.solution: Leveraged Django's built-in query filtering, class-based generic views, CSRF tokens, and template tags to enforce secure publication rules and seamless pagination.
caseStudy.result: A responsive full-stack blog platform with author management, post drafts, dynamic slug-based routing, database-backed search, and administrative control.
caseStudy.whatILearned: Mastered the Django MVT architecture, relational database schema design, ORM query optimization, server-rendered dynamic templates, and full-stack project deployment.

faqs.question: Who is Abhijeet Mahakur?
faqs.answer: Abhijeet Mahakur is a B.Tech Computer Science & Engineering student at ITER, SOA University in Bhubaneswar, Odisha, India. He is a passionate software developer and creative technologist specializing in software development, AI/ML, computer vision, and modern web applications.

faqs.question: What are Abhijeet's core technical skills?
faqs.answer: His core programming languages include Java, Python, and JavaScript/TypeScript. His web stack includes React, Django, HTML5, and CSS3. In AI/ML, he works with computer vision tools like OpenCV and MediaPipe, alongside strong fundamentals in Data Structures & Algorithms and Database systems.

faqs.question: What featured projects has he built?
faqs.answer:
His three main projects are:
1. GraviSphere: An interactive physics and gravity simulation workstation with 3D animation.
2. Air Writing System: A computer vision gesture drawing system using Python, OpenCV, and MediaPipe.
3. Django Blog Website: A robust full-stack blog platform with relational ORM and dynamic templates.
